title: A Sigil for the Salt
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Ada Nystrom, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
